description: Whole timer frames and independent functional clocks (REQ-007; C19, C20, C21; G06; R15, R17, R42, R49, R53, R67, R96, R98, R102, R103, R119) delivered through the shared whole timer body DeadlineTimer (src/ui/refinements/deadline-timer.tsx, consolidating the former TimerFrame and the shipped TimerDisplay positions), the clock reading contract (src/state/timed-clock.ts) over each clock's existing owner, and every consumer — GlobalTimer, RestTimerBar, MovementCountdownView, the EMOM, AMRAP, scheduled-ladder and circuit countdowns, the circuit round clock and ForTimeClock — with the one-row .clr-workout-header recipe (src/ui/refinements/presentation.css), on the real /workout route and its open logging sheet (JOURNEY-007), and the accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=cards and ?state=urgency (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) drawing the actual consumers. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-007 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/state/timed-clock.test.ts src/ui/timer-frame-layout.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
